notes.title: A push at the right time
notes.science: A small push at the right moment can change where someone ends up. One more joiner can tip a crowd that was nearly ready.
notes.limits: The wind here moves bodies and, now and then, a dial. It cannot make up anyone's mind.
notes.counter: Some say people go where they were going anyway, and a push only picks the day.
notes.question: Was it the wind, or was it Wisp?

sources.label: Threshold Models of Collective Behavior, Granovetter, 1978
The Wisdom and/or Madness of Crowds, Nicky Case

notes.title: Leaving
notes.science: People leave groups for many reasons. Some leave when speaking up changes nothing.
notes.limits: Here a creature that crosses the ridge stays gone for a long time. It still writes.
notes.counter: Some leavings are a start. A creature who goes can bring something back.
notes.question: Would Wisp have gone without the wind?

sources.label: Place Attachment: How Far Have We Come in the Last 40 Years?, Lewicka, 2011

wisp: The ridge has a path that nobody here walks. I look at it more than I say.
